COMMANDS:
  scan [PATHS...]                        Discover endpoints in one or more codebases
  list techs | taggers | formats         Enumerate built-in catalogs
  cache info | clear | purge             Manage the on-disk LLM response cache
  config show | edit | init | path       Manage the user-level YAML configuration
  rules list | update | path             Manage the passive-scan rules repository
  completion zsh | bash | fish | elvish  Generate a shell completion script
  version [--verbose]                    Print version (or full build details)

GLOBAL FLAGS:
  --no-color        Strip ANSI color from every command's output (NO_COLOR env also works)
  --no-spinner      Disable loading spinner animations while keeping normal logs
  -v, -V, --version Print the noir version and exit (alias for `noir version`)
  -h, --help        Show this overview, or, after a verb, that command's help

Run `noir help <command>` (or `noir <command> -h`) for command-specific flags.

USAGE:
  noir scan [PATHS...] [flags]

EXAMPLES:
  Basic scan
    noir scan ./myapp

  JSON output to file
    noir scan ./myapp -f json -o endpoints.json

  Enable passive security scan
    noir scan ./myapp -P

  AI integration
    $ noir scan . --ai-provider openai --ai-model gpt-5.5 --ai-key YOUR_API_KEY
    $ noir scan . --ai-provider acp:codex
    $ noir scan . --ai-provider acp:claude

  Replay endpoints through Burp/ZAP
    noir scan ./myapp --probe-via http://127.0.0.1:8080 -u http://target

FLAGS:
 BASE:
    -b PATH, --base-path PATH        Add a base path to scan (positional paths work too; repeatable)
    -u URL, --url http://...         Prepend this base URL to every discovered path; required for --status-codes, --probe, and --probe-via

 OUTPUT:
    -f FMT, --format json            Output format:
                                       plain            Plain text (default)
                                       yaml             YAML
                                       json             JSON
                                       jsonl            JSON Lines
                                       toml             TOML
                                       markdown-table   Markdown table
                                       sarif            SARIF format
                                       html             HTML report
                                       curl             cURL commands
                                       httpie           HTTPie commands
                                       powershell       PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest commands
                                       adb              ADB commands for Android entry points
                                       simctl           simctl commands for iOS entry points
                                       oas2             OpenAPI 2.0 (Swagger)
                                       oas3             OpenAPI 3.0
                                       postman          Postman collection
                                       only-url         Only endpoint URLs
                                       only-param       Only parameters
                                       only-header      Only headers
                                       only-cookie      Only cookies
                                       only-tag         Only tags
                                       mermaid          Mermaid diagram
    -o PATH, --output out.txt        Write result to file
        --pvalue TYPE=VAL            Set parameter value (TYPE: any|header|cookie|query|form|json|path; repeatable)
        --status-codes               Display HTTP status codes
        --exclude-codes 404,500      Exclude HTTP codes (comma-separated; repeatable)
        --exclude-path PATTERN       Exclude files by glob (e.g. *.test.js,*_test.go; repeatable)
        --include LIST               Enrich plain output (comma-separated: path,techs,callee)
        --ai-context [LIST]          Include aggregated AI review context. With no argument, emits every
                                     category (guards, callee, sources, sinks, validators, signals). Pass a
                                     comma-separated subset to narrow the output:
                                       --ai-context guards,sinks
                                       --ai-context=callee
        --no-color                   Disable color output
        --no-spinner                 Disable loading spinner animations
        --no-log                     Show only results

 PASSIVE SCAN:
    -P, --passive-scan               Enable passive security scan
        --passive-scan-path PATH     Use a custom passive-rule directory (replaces the bundled rules; repeatable)
        --passive-scan-severity LVL  Min severity (critical|high|medium|low, default: high)
        --passive-scan-auto-update   Auto-update rules at startup
        --passive-scan-no-update-check
                                     Skip rule update check

 TAGGER:
    -T, --use-all-taggers            Activate all taggers
        --use-taggers LIST           Activate specific taggers (comma-separated; repeatable)

 PROBE:
        --probe                      Fire HTTP requests at discovered endpoints (needs -u)
        --probe-via URL              Route probes through this proxy URL
        --probe-header VAL           Add header to each probe (repeatable)
        --probe-match VAL            Only probe endpoints matching pattern (repeatable)
        --probe-skip VAL             Skip endpoints matching pattern (repeatable)
        --tls-skip-verify            Skip TLS cert verification for probe/export/webhook (insecure; for self-signed hosts)

 EXPORT:
        --export-es URL              Index endpoints in Elasticsearch
        --export-opensearch URL      Index endpoints in OpenSearch (ES-protocol compatible)
        --export-webhook URL         POST endpoint catalog as JSON to a webhook URL

 AI Integration:
        --ai-provider PREFIX|URL     Specify AI provider prefix or full custom URL (required for AI features).
                                     
                                     Supported prefixes:
                                       openai     → https://api.openai.com/v1
                                       xai        → https://api.x.ai/v1
                                       github     → https://models.github.ai/inference
                                       azure      → https://models.inference.ai.azure.com
                                       openrouter → https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
                                       ollama     → http://localhost:11434/v1
                                       lmstudio   → http://localhost:1234/v1
                                       vllm       → http://localhost:8000/v1
                                       acp:codex  → npx @zed-industries/codex-acp
                                       acp:gemini → gemini --experimental-acp
                                       acp:claude → npx @zed-industries/claude-agent-acp
                                     
                                     Or use a custom URL directly:
                                       --ai-provider http://localhost:8000/v1
        --ai-model NAME              Model name (optional for acp:* providers)
        --ai-key KEY                 API key (or set NOIR_AI_KEY env)
        --ai-agent                   Enable agentic AI workflow (iterative tool-calling loop)
        --ai-agent-max-steps N       Max steps for AI agent loop (default: 20)
        --ai-native-tools-allowlist LIST
                                     Provider allowlist for native tool-calling (comma-separated; repeatable; default: openai,xai,github)
        --ai-max-token N             Max tokens per request

 DIFF:
        --diff-path PATH             Old code version for diff

 TECHNOLOGIES:
    -t LIST, --techs rails,php       Add these techs to the analyzer set (in addition to auto-detected ones; repeatable)
        --only-techs LIST            Restrict auto-detection to these tech detectors (repeatable)
        --exclude-techs LIST         Drop these techs from the final result after detection (repeatable)

 CONFIG:
        --config-file PATH           YAML config file
        --concurrency N              Concurrency level

 CACHE:
        --cache-disable              Disable LLM cache
        --cache-clear                Clear LLM cache before run

 DEBUG:
    -d, --debug                      Enable debug messages
        --verbose                    Verbose mode (+ --include path + --use-all-taggers)
    -h, --help                       Show this help

USAGE:
  noir list <subject> [-f/--format text|json|yaml]

SUBJECTS:
  techs                  Supported technologies and analyzer details
  taggers                Built-in and framework-specific taggers
  formats                Supported output formats

OPTIONS:
  -f, --format <fmt>     Output as text (default), json, or yaml

LEGACY ALIASES (still work in v1.x):
  --list-techs           → noir list techs
  --list-taggers         → noir list taggers

USAGE:
  noir cache <action>

ACTIONS:
  info                   Show cache location, entry count, size, and oldest/newest entry
  clear                  Remove every cached AI response
  purge <days>           Remove cached entries older than N days

SCAN-TIME FLAGS (control cache per scan run):
  --cache-disable        Disable cache reads/writes for that scan
  --cache-clear          Clear the cache before that scan runs

Environment:
  NOIR_CACHE_DISABLE=1   Disables the cache regardless of CLI flags

USAGE:
  noir config <action>

ACTIONS:
  show                   Print the contents of the active config file
  edit                   Open the config file in $VISUAL / $EDITOR
  init                   Create the default config file (idempotent)
  path                   Print the resolved config file path

OPTIONS:
  --config-file PATH     Operate on PATH instead of the default config file.
                         Applies to show, edit, and path; init always
                         creates the default file and ignores this flag.

The config directory is controlled by NOIR_HOME (defaults to
$HOME/.config/noir on Unix and %APPDATA%\noir on Windows).

`edit` resolves the editor in the order $VISUAL, $EDITOR, then a
platform default (vi on Unix, notepad on Windows). The config
file is created first if it does not yet exist.

USAGE:
  noir rules <action> [options]

ACTIONS:
  list                   Show rule files installed under the rules path
  update                 Pull the latest rules from the upstream repository
  path                   Print the configured rules directory

OPTIONS:
  -v, --verbose          Show verbose progress (update)
  --debug                Show debug diagnostics, e.g. why an update failed
  -h, --help             Show this help

Default rules path: ~/.config/noir/passive_rules (overridable via NOIR_HOME).

During scan, rules are activated with `noir scan ... -P` (--passive-scan)
and can be aimed at a custom location with `--passive-scan-path PATH`.

USAGE:
  noir completion <shell>

SHELLS:
  zsh                    Generate Zsh completion script
  bash                   Generate Bash completion script
  fish                   Generate Fish completion script
  elvish                 Generate Elvish completion script

Pipe the output to your shell's completion path — these create the
target dir first so they work on a fresh macOS/Linux setup:
  noir completion zsh    > "${fpath[1]}/_noir"
  mkdir -p ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions
  noir completion bash   > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/noir
  mkdir -p ~/.config/fish/completions
  noir completion fish   > ~/.config/fish/completions/noir.fish
  mkdir -p ~/.config/elvish/lib
  noir completion elvish > ~/.config/elvish/lib/noir.elv
                          # then `use noir` from ~/.config/elvish/rc.elv

USAGE:
  noir version [--verbose]

OPTIONS:
  --verbose              Also show Crystal/LLVM/target build details
                          (replaces v0 `--build-info`).

LEGACY ALIASES:
  noir -v
  noir -V
  noir --version
  noir --build-info      → noir version --verbose

help.text:
USAGE:
  noir <command> [arguments] [flags]
  noir [flags]                       # v0-compatible: routes to `noir scan`

COMMANDS:
  scan [PATHS...]                        Discover endpoints in one or more codebases
  list techs | taggers | formats         Enumerate built-in catalogs
  cache info | clear | purge             Manage the on-disk LLM response cache
  config show | edit | init | path       Manage the user-level YAML configuration
  rules list | update | path             Manage the passive-scan rules repository
  completion zsh | bash | fish | elvish  Generate a shell completion script
  version [--verbose]                    Print version (or full build details)
  help [command]                         Show this overview or a command's help

GLOBAL FLAGS:
  --no-color        Strip ANSI color from every command's output (NO_COLOR env also works)
  --no-spinner      Disable loading spinner animations while keeping normal logs
  -v, -V, --version Print the noir version and exit (alias for `noir version`)
  -h, --help        Show this overview, or, after a verb, that command's help

Run `noir help <command>` (or `noir <command> -h`) for command-specific flags.

--ai-agent.help: Enable agentic AI workflow (iterative tool-calling loop)

--ai-agent-max-steps.help: Maximum steps for AI agent loop (default: `20`)

--ai-native-tools-allowlist.help: Provider allowlist for native tool-calling (comma-separated, default: `openai,xai,github`)

--ai-provider.help: AI provider prefix (e.g., `openai`, `ollama`, `acp:codex`) or custom API URL

--config-file.help: Specify the path to a configuration file in YAML format

--diff-path.help: Specify the path to the old version of the source code for comparison

--exclude-techs.help: Exclude the specified technologies from the scan.

--export-opensearch.help: speaks the same HTTP protocol as Elasticsearch.

--export-webhook.help: POSTs the endpoint catalog as a single JSON document (`{endpoints, endpoint_count, noir_version}`) to any HTTP receiver (Slack incoming webhooks, Discord, Zapier/n8n, custom internal endpoints).

--help.help: Show this overview, or, after a verb, that command's help

--include-path.help: Include file path in the plain result

--no-color.help: Strip ANSI color from every command's output (NO_COLOR env also works)

--no-spinner.help: Disable loading spinner animations while keeping normal logs

--ollama.help: Set the Ollama server URL. Use `--ai-provider` instead.

--ollama-model.help: Specify the model for the Ollama server. Use `--ai-model` instead.

--only-techs.help: Restrict auto-detection to these tech detectors (comma-separated, e.g., `rails,django`).

--passive-scan-no-update-check.help: Skip update checks (useful for air-gapped environments)

--set-pvalue.help: Specifies the value of the identified parameter

--techs.help: Add these techs to the analyzer set in addition to auto-detected ones (comma-separated, e.g., `rails,django`).

--use-all-taggers.help: Activates all taggers for full analysis coverage

--use-filters.help: Exclude matching endpoints (URL, method, or method:URL)

--use-matchers.help: Only send matching endpoints (URL, method, or method:URL)
